title: Chronicle Randomization Receipt v1
description: ADR-0010 §2: the record of an external randomization the engine consumes — today the order in which a Burn Out recycles the Trash into the Main Deck (Core 431.2.b). Never a player's choice and never the engine's: it names the operation it serves, the complete permutation, and who produced it how.

operation_id.description: The Burn Out this receipt serves, e.g. burn_out:<player>:<turn_id>:<n>; the consuming procedure names it in its decision_ids when the receipt is missing.

permutation.description: Every object id of the Trash at the moment of the Recycle, in the new Main Deck order (top first).
